description: Parkings vélos - Seneffe is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Commune de Seneffe. Cette base de données recense l'ensemble des parkings vélos présents sur le territoire de la Commune de Seneffe. Elle est amenée à évoluer. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are vélos, parking, parkingvélo, vélo. The portal shows 24 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-05-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
